universalaction.fast: A Child in Need. School gardener Banner suspects a student is being abused; guest Sally Kirkland.
747. The Hulk and a young boy (Brandon Cruz) must land a jetliner.
Goliath Returns. Garthe Knight leads Michael into a confrontation by kidnapping Devon, April and the scientist Michael was hired to protect.
Goliath Returns. Michael (David Hasselhoff) and Christina (Suzanne Barnes) try to destroy Goliath and rescue Devon (Edward Mulhare), April (Rebecca Holden) and Dr. Bergstrom...
Dilemma. Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.
Hangup. Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.
Crash. Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.
Problem. DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.
Kids. Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.
Show Biz. Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.
Virus. A mysterious virus strikes Brackett, Gage and a firefighter; the paramedics aid a teenage vertigo victim; guest Cathy Lee Crosby.
Peace Pipe. The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.
Saddled. The paramedics rescue the driver and passengers of a school bus that plunged over a cliff; Gage dreams of becoming a rich rodeo star.
Fuzz Lady. Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.
Steel. A struggling contractor's (Norman Alden) warehouse-demolition site is sabotaged by a mob-hired competitor.
The White Ballot. Face becomes a candidate for sheriff to expose a small-town law officer's shady dealings. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.
The Maltese Cow. The team foils both an international dope deal and extortionists preying on a Chinese restaurateur (Keye Luke).
In Plane Sight. The team must flush a major cocaine trafficker out of Colombia to help a young woman clear her uncle of drug-smuggling.
The Battle of Bel Air. Reporter Tawnia Baker poses as a computer operator to help the team capture terrorists plotting to assassinate a sheik.
Say It With Bullets. A woman hires the team to investigate the murder of her brother, who was part of a munitions theft operation.
Pure-Dee Poison. The team helps a Southern minister (John Amos) break a ring selling poisonous moonshine; guests Bo Hopkins, Tracy Reed.
It's a Desert Out There. The team fights robbers, led by a bandit (Jeannie Wilson), who ambush tour buses leaving a run-down Nevada casino.
Chopping Spree. The team investigates a used-car dealer (Dennis Franz) marketing stolen auto parts.
The Hulk Breaks Las Vegas. Banner helps a Las Vegas reporter investigate a gambling scandal.
The Waterfront Story. Banner gets involved in a war for control of dockworkers union in Galveston, Texas.
Earthquakes Happen. To gain access to its gamma ray equipment, David impersonates a scientist inspecting a nuclear research facility.
Never Give a Trucker an Even Break. Banner winds up in the middle of a war between a woman trucker and a pair of hijackers.
Life and Death. Banner finds danger for himself and pregnant woman when he volunteers for genetic research.
God's Work. The return of a financial wizard (Esai Morales) sets off speculation in the Miami underworld; guest Rosana DeSoto.
Missing Hours. The recently discovered body of a man who was missing for two years disappears. Guest star: singer James Brown. With Don Johnson and Philip Michael Thomas.
A Good Knight's Work. Michael helps a toy maker and is targeted for death by old adversary Cameron Zachary (John Vernon).
Mouth of the Snake. Michael and KITT help a reclusive agent and the widow probe a government lawyer's murder.
Mouth of the Snake. The team links the lawyer's murder to a gangster smuggling gold to finance an attack.
Let It Be Me. Michael poses as a singer to help an old love (Catherine Hickland) solve a musician's suspicious overdose.
Big Iron. Former partners (Stuart Whitman, Myron Healy), now competitors, are suspected of hijacking construction equipment.
The Knight of the Drones. A weapons designer plans a major theft.
The Knight of the Drones. Halston reveals his true objective.
Ice Bandits. Michael and KITT track diamond thieves to wine-producing monks in the Napa Valley.
Knights of the Fast Lane. A football-team owner injures a woman in a hit-and-run accident.
Halloween Knight. Flu-sufferer Bonnie sees a man in a gorilla suit strangle a woman, but no one will believe her.
KITT vs. KARR. An auto mechanic recovers and repairs KITT's prototype, unaware of its evil capacities.
The Rotten Apples. Michael and K.I.T.T. attempt to stop cattle rustling in Sage City.
Double Trouble. Steve poses as a bodyguard to capture enemy agents electronically controlling a nightclub comic (Flip Wilson).
The Most Dangerous Enemy. A chimpanzee injected with an experiment serum bites Rudy Wells, turning him into a superhuman madman; guest Ina Balin.
H Plus 2 Plus O Equals Death. Steve poses as a traitorous scientist to expose a spy ring that stole plans for a secret underwater breathing apparatus.
KILL OSCAR (SIM) /PT2. Scientists save an astronaut by implanting him with high-tech devices.
The Bionic Boy. A paralyzed 16-year-old (Vincent Van Patten) receives bionic limbs and is put under Steve's guidance.
The Bionic Boy. Bionic Andy (Vincent Van Patten) tries to clear his father's name; guests Greg Evigan, Dick Van Patten.
Jaime and the King. Jaime works as tutor to a difficult prince (Lance Kerwin) to protect his father, a Middle East oil magnate, from assassins.
Beyond the Call. Jaime tries to befriend the withdrawn half-Vietnamese daughter of a major (Sam Groom) planning to steal missile secrets.
The DeJon Caper. Jaime is arrested while in Paris to trap a criminal and retrieve stolen paintings.
The Night Demon. A creature from Indian lore confronts Jaime in an ancient burial ground, now part of a ranch.
Iron Ships and Dead Men. Jaime helps Oscar clear the name of his brother, who disappeared with $250,000 during the attack on Pearl Harbor.
Once a Thief. Posing as a bank robber, Jaime is blackmailed into participating in a real heist.
The Bionic Dog. Jaime discovers the existence of the world's first bionic dog and has just five days to save it from destruction.
The Bionic Dog. Max runs off in the Sierra Nevada mountains, Jaime and an old flame follow him into a raging forest fire.
Knight in Disgrace. Michael must clear himself of false drug charges.
Dead of Knight. A dancer dies from poison gas meant for Michael, who searches desperately for its source.
Trainee. A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.
Women!. An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.
Dinner Date. DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.
Musical Mania. Gage's musical efforts irritate Station 51; rescue calls range from frostbite to a man trapped beneath his sliding canyon-home.
Helpful. An exhausted and emotionally upset woman doctor disappears from the hospital; Gage tries to help DeSoto with a marital difficulty.
Drivers. An all-star college quarterback collapses suddenly; Gage wants to discipline motorists who fail to yield to fire department vehicles.
School Days. The paramedics try to boost the confidence of a trainee who has doubts about his readiness to take on emergency duties in the field.
The Professor. Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.
Syndrome. Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).
Honest. Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.
Harder Than It Looks. The team rescues an heiress (Lori Lethin) from terrorists, only to have her insist on returning to save her terrorist lover.
Deadly Maneuvers. Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.
Semi-Friendly Persuasion. The team abides by a cult's nonviolent philosophy to defeat corrupt townspeople who burned their community building.
Curtain Call. The team recalls incidents of Murdock's bravery and loyalty while he lies badly wounded by a bullet meant for Hannibal.
Bullets and Bikinis. The team flies to Miami to wage war against gangsters threatening to take over a resort hotel owned by two sisters.
The Bend in the River. Tawnia recruits the team to save her adventurer fiancé, captured by Amazon River pirates while searching for a lost city.
The Bend in the River. The captured team discovers a secret in the jungle and must enlist El Cajon's assistance to destroy a deadly installation.
Fire!. The team helps a fire chief (Stepfanie Kramer) save her one-truck company from takeover by a larger operation.
Timber!. The team helps brother-and-sister lumberjacks thwart a crooked union boss intent on driving them out of business.
Ricky. At a New Mexico track, Banner helps a race driver's mentally impaired brother; guest Gerald McRaney.
